purpose: Teach: プログラマー/ユーティリティ/短大/本学/南側/伝送/陳列/懲戒

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者にプログラマー出身者が増えてますね
lines.en: I've noticed more suspects with programming backgrounds showing up in police cases.
lines.style: Conversational, observational tone. Casual but respectful. Light, curious inflection — not challenging, just noticing. Warm and open.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場のユーティリティナイフ携帯にも注意されますね
lines.en: And police are really careful about utility knives found at crime scenes, aren't they?
lines.style: Continuing the thread, slightly more detailed. Still collaborative in tone. Soft emphasis on 'careful' — acknowledging competence without flattery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、短大での防犯講演もされますね
lines.en: They also give crime prevention talks at junior colleges, I understand.
lines.style: Still collaborative. Gentle conversational lift on the observation. Not stating fact but inviting agreement. Warm and inclusive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本学関連の研究者連携もされますね
lines.en: And there's coordination with researchers from your university too, isn't there?
lines.style: Personal touch now — 'your university' brings it closer. Still warm, still collaborative. Light curiosity, genuinely interested in the connection.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯行現場の南側からの侵入経路も調べられますね
lines.en: They investigate entry routes from the south side of crime scenes as well.
lines.style: Back to broader detail. Steady, factual delivery. Conversational but precise — respecting the specificity of the work. Open and engaged.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、無線伝送の傍受技術もお持ちですね
lines.en: I understand they have expertise in intercepting radio transmissions too.
lines.style: Impressed but understated. Slight lift of respect in the tone. Not awed, just acknowledging skill. Still collaborative and warm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の陳列管理を徹底されますね
lines.en: They're very thorough about managing seized evidence displays, aren't they?
lines.style: Approving, steady tone. Respectful of the diligence. Conversational, not lecturing. Warm acknowledgment of professionalism.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警官の懲戒処分も厳格におこなわれますね
lines.en: And officer disciplinary proceedings are handled quite strictly, I believe.
lines.style: Tone shifts slightly — more serious now, slightly more formal. Still warm but with weight. Respectful of the accountability. Deliberate pace.
